metrics_after.note: 6-sample smoke; JSON parse was the dominant failure

change: LlmClient: JSON Schema constrained decoding (llama.cpp response_format.json_schema, capability-probed) + multi-stage parser (direct/fenced/balanced) + error-stage classification + temperature 0.1
root_cause: 3B model free-text JSON broke parsing ~50% of calls

change: planner schema: capability enum constraint + prompt wording (capability must be an action name)
root_cause: model filled capability with domain names (cover/climate)

change: number extraction from strings and mode normalization (hvac_mode nested objects)
root_cause: model emitted values like '32%' and nested mode objects

change: parameter-object normalization (function-calling style values like {"brightness": 0.8} -> scalar percent)
root_cause: model wrapped values in parameter objects

change: goal compiler few-shot examples (implicit goals: glare, sleepy-but-awake)
root_cause: 3B model judged implicit comfort goals as not-home-goal

change: schema repair: contradictory output (is_home_goal=false but valid constraints) trusts the constraints
root_cause: model boolean flag contradicted its own constraints

change: benchmark driver switched to closed-loop convergence (plan->execute->evolve->replan, matching AgentRuntime semantics)
root_cause: single-round execution undercounted the converging autonomy loop

change: semantic retry for is_home_goal=false (repair prompt, max 2 attempts)
root_cause: boolean goal judgement flickered between calls on small model

change: full_llm_chain metric fixed to credit converged no-action chains (llm_candidate_seen across rounds)
root_cause: metric bug: successful converged chains counted as chain failures
